spans.s:
A long vowel is substituted for the final vowel of the preceding word, before the verbs 1. नह् 2. वृत् 3. वृष् 4. व्यध् 5. रुच् 6. सह् and 7. तन् when these roots take the affix क्वि।

Terms: संहिता changes

The finite verb retains its accent in connection with नह when used in the sense of forbidding.

Terms: Accent

The ह of नह् is changed to ध before a before a झल् (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) letter or at the end of a word.

Terms: ह changed to ध
